Product:{\"sku\":\"7100127186\"}.name: Pixel Hunters: Turn Retro Consoles into your Girlfriend
Product:{\"sku\":\"7100127186\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Somewhere between the attic and the flea market, retro consoles have started fighting back. Old machines, blinking cursors, cartridges with a mind of their own. Something's alive in there.

Battle them turn by turn, wear them down, then catch them.

That's when the real surprise hits: every console you capture transforms into an anime girl carrying pieces of its old hardware personality.

Take her on dates, make the right choices, and watch the bond grow.

• The stubborn beige box that never wanted to boot up? Meet the girl who takes forever to warm up to you, but is worth every second.
• The tiny handheld that fit in your pocket? She's quick, playful, and always one step ahead.
• The chunky console with the flashing red light? Turns out she runs hot and burns just as fast for you.


Features:

♥ CAPTURE & TRANSFORM: Battle retro machines, capture them, and watch them become anime girls with personalities pulled straight from their old hardware quirks.

♥ TURN-BASED COMBAT: Outsmart every console before it powers down on you. Strategy meets seduction.

♥ ROMANCE & VISUAL NOVEL CHOICES: Take her on dates, say the right thing, unlock secret memories and scenes.

♥ CHARACTER COLLECTION: Every console has its own anime form and its own personality. Collect them all.

♥ MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Not every route ends the same way. Choose wisely.


Yes, you read that right. You're about to date your old game console.
Ready to hit start?
